name: Portable Rechargeable Nebulizer Machine Asthma Inhaler 0.5L for Kids and Adults

The Portable Rechargeable Nebulizer is designed for effective asthma and respiratory relief for both kids and adults. A safe and reliable medical-grade device, it provides daily support for asthma, cough, and breathing difficulties.
Key Features
 Rechargeable and portable design
 Suitable for children and adults
 Lightweight at only 400g
 0.5L capacity for effective use
 Helps relieve asthma, cough, and respiratory issues
 Ideal for home or travel care
Ingredients / Materials
Medical-grade plastic, electronic components
How to Use
 Fill the nebulizer chamber with prescribed solution
 Attach mouthpiece or mask
 Power on and inhale medication mist
 Clean parts after each use
